source_data.desc:
Rising up from the seafloor is a nightmarish creature resembling an obese mermaid with a wide, fluked tail, claws, and a humanoid head with a fish-like mouth and large, saucer-like, yellow eyes. An organ like the anchor of a boat emerges from its brow, shedding a pale blue light that glimmers off its iridescent crimson scales._  
**Monster Creator.** Yavalnois are wicked aberrations capable of procreating with almost any creature from the sea, be it a Open Game License
source_data.name: Yavalnoi

en.description:
Rising up from the seafloor is a nightmarish creature resembling an obese mermaid with a wide, fluked tail, claws, and a humanoid head with a fish-like mouth and large, saucer-like, yellow eyes. An organ like the anchor of a boat emerges from its brow, shedding a pale blue light that glimmers off its iridescent crimson scales._  
**Monster Creator.** Yavalnois are wicked aberrations capable of procreating with almost any creature from the sea, be it a Open Game License

ru.description: Поднимаясь с морского дна — кошмарное существо, напоминающее ожиревшую русалку с широким, ластообразным хвостом, когтями и гуманоидной головой с рыбьим ртом и большими, блюдцевидными, жёлтыми глазами. Орган, как якорь лодки, выходит из её лба, излучая бледно-синий свет, который мерцает на её переливающейся малиновой чешуе.
ru.name: Явалной
